description: Internal static class 'Decoder' for PNG image decoding, including handling of interlaced and non-interlaced PNG images, filtering, and pixel data processing within the PDFsharp library.

methods.name: GetBytesAndSamplesPerPixel
methods.description: Calculates bytes per pixel and samples per pixel based on image header.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes decompressed PNG data considering interlace method, applying filters and reconstructing pixel data.

methods.name: SamplesPerPixel
methods.description: Determines number of samples per pixel based on color type.

methods.name: BytesPerScanline
methods.description: Calculates the number of bytes per scanline based on image width, bit depth, and samples per pixel.

methods.name: ReverseFilter
methods.description: Applies PNG filter algorithms to reconstruct original pixel data from filtered data.

methods.name: GetPaethValue
methods.description: Calculates the Paeth predictor value used in PNG filtering.
